insights.one_liner: Hunkemöller is a 140-year-old Dutch lingerie brand with shops across Europe, an IND recognised sponsor with head-office roles in Hilversum.

culture.text: A Dutch lingerie and underwear brand with shops across Europe; current roles are at its Hilversum office.
Its brand director started out as an intern at the company.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (Hunkemöller B.V. and Hunkemöller International B.V.).
Both current jobs (operations and product management) don't require Dutch.

growth.text: Celebrated its 140th anniversary with a Vogue Nederland archive expo.
At least one local store, in De Hoven, has closed.

worth_knowing.text: It is in a legal dispute with noteholders over a debt restructuring; an English court paused the claim pending New York litigation.
Its roles are popular, averaging 75 applicants each on LinkedIn.
